# n = 2175 inventories, one per Glottocode (first InventoryID), as phoible_segments.tsv.

# kind=series: value = share of inventories with at least one member of the series (the predicates of planet/language/inventory.py SERIES over percepts.parse_segment of each phoneme); extra = mean members where present.

# kind=series_bin: the same share among inventories in one size bin (key series|C<bin> for consonant series by consonant count, series|V<bin> for vowel series by vowel count); extra = inventories in the bin.

# kind=v_ratio: value = mean of (members of the vowel series / distinct vowel qualities) over inventories with the series; extra = those inventories (sound lane pass 2: how many vowel slots a series takes).
# kind=rare_c_share: value = mean share of an inventory's consonants with PHOIBLE frequency < 0.1, by consonant count bin; extra = inventories in the bin.
